mnemonic.meaning: MARU means "circle": the two things are so alike they come full circle. まるで〜のよう = just like.

examples.ja: 彼はまるで子供のように笑った。
examples.en: He laughed just like a child.

items.note: まるで〜ようだ / みたいだ = as if. With a negative it means "not at all": まるで分からない.

mnemonic.meaning: SHIKA + MO: "and on top of that, MOre!" It piles one fact on another.

examples.ja: この店は安い。しかも、おいしい。
examples.en: This place is cheap. And what's more, it's tasty.

items.note: Adds a stronger second point: 失敗した。しかも二回も。(I failed, and twice at that.) Also "and yet": 注意された。しかも、また同じ間違いをした。

mnemonic.meaning: 奥 looks like a big room with something hidden deep inside. The inner part, way at the back.
mnemonic.reading: Your keys are at the back of the drawer: "OH, KU-rse, they're all the way in the back!" (おく)

examples.ja: 引き出しの奥に古い手紙があった。
examples.en: There was an old letter at the back of the drawer.

items.note: 奥さん (someone's wife) comes from 奥: the person in the back of the house, in old Japan.

mnemonic.meaning: 場 has 土 (earth): a patch of ground where something happens. A place or occasion.
mnemonic.reading: BA! You land on the spot. (ば) Same ば as 場所 and 会場.

examples.ja: その場ですぐに返事をした。
examples.en: I replied right there on the spot.

items.note: Common in set phrases: その場で (on the spot), 場合 (case). On its own, ば is a bit formal; 場所 is the everyday word.

mnemonic.meaning: SORE + SORE: "that one, and that one". Each thing taken one by one.

examples.ja: 人にはそれぞれ好みがある。
examples.en: Everyone has their own tastes.

items.note: Often 〜はそれぞれ違う: each one is different. Close to 各自 (かくじ) but more everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 描 has 扌 (hand) next to a field: your hand drawing the field. To draw or depict.
mnemonic.reading: "Ay! GAKU!" says the art teacher as you draw. (えがく) It can also be read かく.

examples.ja: この小説は戦争の悲しさを描いている。
examples.en: This novel depicts the sadness of war.

items.note: えがく is a bit literary: depict, portray, picture in your mind. かく is the plain "draw" (絵を描く is usually read かく). Both are written 描く.

mnemonic.meaning: NAN = what, TOKA = or something. "Somehow or other" you get through.

examples.ja: なんとか終電に間に合った。
examples.en: I somehow made the last train.

items.note: なんとかする = do something about it. なんとかなる = it'll work out somehow.

mnemonic.meaning: 件 = 亻 (person) + 牛 (cow). A person arguing about a cow: a matter to deal with.
mnemonic.reading: KEN, your coworker, handles every case. (けん)

examples.ja: その件については、後で話しましょう。
examples.en: Let's talk about that matter later.

items.note: Used a lot at work: この件 (this matter). As a counter it counts cases or emails: 3件.

mnemonic.meaning: 抱 has 扌 (hand) wrapping around: holding something close. Also holding a feeling inside.
mnemonic.reading: "EE, DAKU!" You hug the duck tight. (いだく)

examples.ja: 彼は将来に不安を抱いている。
examples.en: He holds worries about the future.

items.note: いだく is for feelings (hope, doubt, dreams). だく is a physical hug, as in 赤ちゃんを抱く.

mnemonic.meaning: 例 = 亻 (person) + 列 (line): a person at the front of the line, setting the example.
mnemonic.reading: RAY points to an example on the board. (れい) Same れい as 例えば.

examples.ja: 例を挙げて説明してください。
examples.en: Please explain with an example.

items.note: 例の + noun = "that ... we talked about": 例の件 (that matter).

mnemonic.meaning: IZURE sounds like "is your..." turn coming? Sooner or later, it will.

examples.ja: いずれ分かる日が来るよ。
examples.en: The day will come when you understand, sooner or later.

items.note: いずれにしても = in any case. いずれ also means "either one" in formal speech.

mnemonic.meaning: MASA + NI: think "MASter-ly" precise. Exactly that, no more, no less.

examples.ja: これはまさに私が探していた本だ。
examples.en: This is exactly the book I was looking for.

items.note: Stronger than ちょうど. Often for emphasis: まさにその通り = exactly right.

mnemonic.meaning: HOBO: a hobo who has almost everything packed. Almost, nearly.

examples.ja: 仕事はほぼ終わった。
examples.en: The work is almost finished.

items.note: A little more formal than だいたい. Common in news: ほぼ毎日 (almost every day).

mnemonic.meaning: 一 one + 方 direction: one direction, while the other goes elsewhere. On the other hand.
mnemonic.reading: IPPO: one step (一歩) to one side. (いっぽう)

examples.ja: 兄は背が高い。一方、弟は小さい。
examples.en: The older brother is tall. The younger one, on the other hand, is small.

items.note: Also the grammar 〜一方だ (keeps getting more and more).

mnemonic.meaning: 流 has 氵 (water): water that keeps moving. A flow or current.
mnemonic.reading: The river flows NAGAREly along... NAGA (long) + RE: a long stream. (ながれ)

examples.ja: 川の流れが速い。
examples.en: The river's current is fast.

items.note: Also used for the flow of time or events: 話の流れ (the flow of a conversation).

mnemonic.meaning: 伸 = 亻 (person) + 申: a person reaching up and getting longer. To stretch or grow.
mnemonic.reading: "NO, BEE-RU (beer) won't make you grow taller!" (のびる)

examples.ja: 子供の背がずいぶん伸びた。
examples.en: The child has gotten a lot taller.

items.note: Also for skills and sales: 成績が伸びる (grades improve). The transitive form is 伸ばす (Level 4).

mnemonic.meaning: 切 = cut. The point where something is cut off: the end or a break.
mnemonic.reading: KIRI: you KEEp cutting until the end. Same き as 切る. (きり)

examples.ja: 切りがいいところで休みましょう。
examples.en: Let's take a break at a good stopping point.

items.note: 切りがない = there's no end to it. Often written in kana: きりがない.

mnemonic.meaning: ITSU (when) + MADE (until) + MO (even): until whenever. Forever.

examples.ja: いつまでも元気でいてください。
examples.en: Please stay healthy forever.

items.note: Warm and common in wishes. ずっと is close but more neutral.

mnemonic.meaning: NAO sounds like "now, oh, and also..." It adds a note: furthermore.

examples.ja: なお、詳しいことは後日お知らせします。
examples.en: In addition, we will announce the details at a later date.

items.note: In notices, なお = "please note". As an adverb, なお + adjective = even more: なおいい.

mnemonic.meaning: 唯 only + 一 one: the only one.
mnemonic.reading: "YOU-EE, it's you, the ICHI (one)!" The one and only. (ゆいいつ)

examples.ja: 彼は私の唯一の友達だ。
examples.en: He is my only friend.

items.note: Used as 唯一の + noun. ただ一つの and たった一人の are softer alternatives.

mnemonic.meaning: 差 is like a hand pointing out a gap between two things. A difference.
mnemonic.reading: SA! You see the gap. (さ) Same さ as 時差 (time difference).

examples.ja: 二人の実力には大きな差がある。
examples.en: There is a big gap in ability between the two.

items.note: 差がつく = a gap opens up. 差がない = no difference.

mnemonic.meaning: MATOMERU: think "MATO" (target): you gather everything onto one target. To sum up.

examples.ja: 会議の内容を一枚にまとめた。
examples.en: I summarized the meeting on one page.

items.note: Intransitive form: まとまる (to come together). まとめて = all at once.

mnemonic.meaning: 以 since + 来 come: since that came about. Ever since.
mnemonic.reading: "EE, RIE!" (いらい) Ever since you met Rie, you've been happy.

examples.ja: 卒業して以来、彼に会っていない。
examples.en: I haven't seen him since we graduated.

items.note: Comes after V-て or a noun: 去年以来 (since last year). Don't confuse with 依頼 (いらい, request), Level 5.

mnemonic.meaning: 至 shows an arrow landing on the ground: it has arrived. To reach a point.
mnemonic.reading: "EE, TA-RU!" You finally reach the tar pit. (いたる)

examples.ja: 長い話し合いの結果、結論に至った。
examples.en: After a long discussion, we arrived at a conclusion.

items.note: Formal. 至るところ = everywhere. 〜に至るまで = all the way down to.

mnemonic.meaning: 不 not + 満 satisfied: not satisfied.
mnemonic.reading: "FOO! MAN!" says the dissatisfied customer. (ふまん)

examples.ja: 社員たちは給料に不満を持っている。
examples.en: The employees are dissatisfied with their pay.

items.note: 不満を言う = to complain. 満足 (まんぞく) is the opposite.

mnemonic.meaning: 全 whole + 体 body: the whole body of something.
mnemonic.reading: ZEN monks look at the whole picture, TAI-t together. (ぜんたい)

examples.ja: クラス全体で話し合った。
examples.en: We talked it over as a whole class.

items.note: 全体的に = overall. 全部 is "all of it", 全体 is "the whole thing as one".

mnemonic.meaning: 含 has 口 (mouth) under a lid: putting something into the mouth. Including it in the group.
mnemonic.reading: "FUKU, ME-RU!" You include your clothes (服) in the mail (メール). (ふくめる)

examples.ja: 税金を含めて千円です。
examples.en: It's 1,000 yen including tax.

items.note: 含める = to include something (you do it). 含む (ふくむ) = to contain (it already does).

mnemonic.meaning: SONO (that) + UCHI (within): within that time. Before long.

examples.ja: そのうち雨もやむでしょう。
examples.en: The rain will stop before long.

items.note: Vague future: "sometime soon". そのうちに is the same.

mnemonic.meaning: IWAYURU: "I WAS YOU-RU (were) calling it..." What people call it.

examples.ja: 彼はいわゆる天才だ。
examples.en: He is what people call a genius.

items.note: Comes right before a noun. Used to introduce a common term, often a little ironic.

mnemonic.meaning: 立 stand + 上 up: stand and go up.
mnemonic.reading: TACHI (stand) + AGARU (rise): "TOUCH-y, I'm rising!" (たちあがる)

examples.ja: 彼は椅子から立ち上がった。
examples.en: He stood up from his chair.

items.note: Also figurative: rise up against something, or a computer starting up.
